Meta.tagline: Map the terrain before you build.

Hero.lede: A Norwegian studio building websites for businesses - small and large. We always start by reading the terrain - then build something that actually stands firm.

nolockin.title: No lock-in
nolockin.body: You own your site - move it anytime.

Process.title: Three steps from idea to website
Process.lede: Every project follows the same map: read the terrain, draw the route, build the path.

step1.title: Survey
step1.body: We ask about your business, who you're speaking to, and what the site needs to do. No building before we know where we're going.

step2.title: Draw the map
step2.body: We sketch structure, design, and content. You see the shape before a single line of code is written.

step3.title: Build
step3.body: We build the site fast and properly - mobile-first, quick, and search-friendly. Then we ship it live.

Portfolio.title: Proof, not promises
Portfolio.lede: Our own products, which we run ourselves - the clearest proof we think like product people, not just coders.

Pricing.title: Straightforward, no surprises
Pricing.lede: Subscription with everything included. You know what you pay for - and what you get.

Faq.title: What people ask
Faq.lede: Common questions from businesses. Didn't find your answer? Send a line.

AboutPage.title: About Aaen Studios
AboutPage.lede: An independent software and digital products studio. We build everything from websites for businesses to our own tools and platforms - always with the same rule: read the terrain before you build.
AboutPage.story: We sit between practical utility and interactivity. Every project starts the same way: survey the terrain, understand the contours, then lay the path. That means scoping honestly, prototyping early, and fast delivery. We don't build on ground we haven't walked.

web.title: Websites for businesses
web.body: Modern websites on subscription - domain, hosting, and maintenance included. Built properly from the first step, no surprises on the invoice.

edtech.title: Interactive platforms
edtech.body: Our own products we run ourselves - like language learning platforms with subscriptions. Each piece placed where it builds naturally on the last, the curriculum mapped like terrain.

opensource.title: Open-Source
opensource.body: Tools and systems that solve real problems for other developers. Clean, minimal surface area. No abandoned repos, no half-documented APIs. If we publish it, we use it - and we maintain it.

founder.title: Elliot Strand Aaen
founder.body: Software developer in Gjøvik. Two years as a full-stack developer at the Norwegian Tax Administration, 16+ projects shipped, NTNU student. Builds everything from websites to Rust desktop apps - with one firm rule: read the map before you build.

contactCta.title: Want to build something together?
contactCta.body: Whether it's a website, a tool, or something else entirely - get in touch.
